novelty_definition.question: is the current state rare relative to recent history?
novelty_definition.rule: rarity = mean over the trailing window of (|primary_feature| >= |primary_feature at t0|); NOVELTY = 1 - rarity

extremeness_definition.question: how far from normal is the state?
extremeness_definition.rule: REUSES the R1 frozen thresholds verbatim; no retuning

persistence_definition.question: is this a state event or a single-bar spike?
persistence_definition.rule: BACKWARD ONLY: count consecutive preceding bars (including t0) whose vol_state equals the vol_state at t0
persistence_definition.forward_persistence: stored as post_event_persistence_observation ONLY (never used in the decision)

crossmarket_definition.question: do independent markets confirm the state?
crossmarket_definition.rule: count of {DXY, VIX, UST10Y_PROXY} with abs(z) >= 2 in the same bar or the preceding 2 bars
crossmarket_definition.note: NONE is not a rejection; a single-market opportunity may still be worth research

recurrence_definition.rule: number of strictly PRIOR opportunities of the same opportunity_type (asof, no future info)

data_quality_definition.semantic_dependency: cross-market opportunities carry SEMANTIC_DEPENDENCY=UNKNOWN (XAUUSD bar semantics UNKNOWN; Yahoo bar semantics UNKNOWN; UST10Y is a PROXY)

decision_matrix_ordered.why: cannot judge, rather than not worth it

decision_matrix_ordered.if: extremeness>=MEDIUM and novelty>=MEDIUM and persistence>=MEDIUM and recurrence>=MEDIUM
